item.title: Version 0.19.5
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.19.5

What’s New

  • Duplicate Link: Right-click any saved link and choose Duplicate to drop a copy right beneath the original.
  • Three New Languages: Traditional Chinese, Russian, and Dutch join the locale list, with polished translations across French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese (Brazil), and Korean.

Improvements

  • Documentation Link: A new Documentation entry in the menu bar and About settings opens the help site in one click.

Bug Fixes

  • Open With on a file now opens in your chosen browser when you pick one from the menu, while regular clicks still open files in your default app and folders in Finder.
  • The sidebar now sizes correctly in fullscreen across all menubar settings, instead of leaving a gap or overlapping a visible menubar.
  • Using a pinned URL shortcut no longer hides the sidebar after opening the link.
